Oncogenic mutations in BRAF, most commonly V600E, drive constitutive activation of the MAPK pathway in ~50% of melanomas. While MEK inhibitors such as trametinib, alone or in combination with BRAF inhibitors, are clinically effective, their therapeutic effects are restricted due to the development of drug resistance. Here we establish a Caenorhabditis elegans model carrying the oncogenic lin-45(V627E) allele, functionally equivalent to human BRAFV600E, to investigate mechanisms of trametinib resistance.
